svg.title: Figure 3-17c. System FMEA failure modes: limits, configuration and the stock functions
svg.desc: Figure 3-17c: 8 System FMEA failure modes, limits, configuration and the stock functions. SFM-029 Actuator command limits not enforced (S 10; H-01, H-03, H-04). Effects: Out-of-limit steering or acceleration messages reach the vehicle / Loss of the main protection against F1/F2 faults on the device / Any upstream fault can produce SFM-002 / SFM-008 / SFM-009 effects ; Contributes to HZ-005: Unintended acceleration ; Contributes to HZ-006: Unintended or excessive deceleration. Causes: SFM-029.C1 Wrong safety model or parameter set for this car (O 3, D 4, M 7, AP L, MSR AP H); SFM-029.C2 Safety model limit defect in firmware (O 6, D 9, M 10, AP H, MSR AP H); SFM-029.C3 Panda MCU hardware fault (see DFMEA/FMEDA) (O 3, D 10, M -, AP H); SFM-029.C4 Harness allows the device to reach a bus without passing the panda filter (O 2, D 10, M 10, AP H, MSR AP M); SFM-029.C5 The panda 100 Hz safety task stops or is starved (defect, interrupt storm, peripheral lock-up), so the RX timeout, heartbeat and TX-arrival checks are not run and no siren is raised. A stopped task resets the MCU through the IWDG in about 90 ms (TSR-501); a task that is starved but still runs is not detected (no WCET) (O 4, D 7, M 10, AP H, MSR AP H); SFM-029.C6 Actuation frames reach the panda faster than nominal (a backlog forwarded back-to-back, or a burst): each frame is within the limits, but the limits apply per frame, not per time. The reference build counts frames per ID over a 250 ms window and revokes after 3 refusals (TSR-518, txRateExceeded); budgets to be confirmed on logs (O 8, D 10, M 10, AP H, MSR AP H); SFM-029.C7 An approved frame is altered after the TX check: in the copy into FDCAN message RAM, the message RAM, the FDCAN core or the transceiver. The packet XOR catches a change in the software queue only (fdcan.h:100); TSR-517 asks for a read-back (SPF-02) (O 3, D 10, M -, AP H); SFM-029.C8 A corrupted SoC-to-MCU SPI transfer passes the 8-bit XOR, so a wrong CAN frame or a wrong control command (safety mode, parameter) is taken. The TX limits still apply to frames; nothing checks control commands (TSR-410, TSR-413; GAP-10) (O 4, D 10, M -, AP H); SFM-029.C9 Safety state in panda SRAM (controls_allowed, limits, counters) corrupted: a soft error or permanent fault with no ECC handling (TSR-503, TSR-507; GAP-08), or a wrong-address write by the SPI DMA when a length field exceeds the buffer (no MPU; TSR-412, WP-S-02 NF-04; WP-A-02 FFI-SP-02) (O 3, D 10, M -, AP H); SFM-029.C10 The panda time base fails or drifts (HSE crystal, PLL). A lost HSE is caught by the clock security system, which resets the MCU (clock.h:118-119); a drift is not detected, so every timeout and rate window scales (TSR-504; reset state TSR-706) (O 3, D 10, M -, AP H); SFM-029.C11 The panda MCU runs in the brown-out zone during a supply dip (BOR level not set, PVD not enabled); the supply voltage is only reported (TSR-505; WP-A-03 DFI-01) (O 5, D 10, M -, AP H). Actions: SFM-ACT-001 open, SFM-ACT-008 in_progress. Fault trees: SG-01 G-ENV; SG-03 G-LENV; SG-04 G-LENV. SFM-030 Excessive actuation not detected (S 10; H-01, H-03, H-04). Effects: excessiveActuation not raised / Item stays engaged during excessive motion / SFM-002/008/009 effects persist ; Contributes to HZ-005: Unintended acceleration ; Contributes to HZ-006: Unintended or excessive deceleration. Causes: SFM-030.C1 Calibrated pose wrong (calibration or IMU fault) (O 5, D 8, M -, AP H); SFM-030.C2 device_motion_valid gate blocks detection when aEgo and IMU disagree (O 6, D 10, M -, AP H). Actions: SFM-ACT-002 open. Fault trees: SG-01 justified; SG-03 justified; SG-04 justified. SFM-031 False excessive-actuation detection (S 8; no hazard). Effects: excessiveActuation raised without excessive motion / Soft disable with alert / Unneeded handback to the driver. Causes: SFM-031.C1 IMU noise or bad mounting (O 5, D 10, M -, AP H). Actions: SFM-ACT-003 open. Fault trees: none. SFM-032 Wrong vehicle configuration active (fingerprint or car port) (S 10; H-01, H-03, H-04). Effects: CarParams, safety model and DBC for a different car / Wrong limits, scaling and message layout / Any F1/F2 effect; possible message conflicts with stock ECUs ; Contributes to HZ-005: Unintended acceleration ; Contributes to HZ-006: Unintended or excessive deceleration. Causes: SFM-032.C1 Fuzzy fingerprint matches a similar platform (O 4, D 9, M 8, AP H, MSR AP H). Actions: SFM-ACT-008 in_progress. Fault trees: SG-01 BE-1.05; SG-03 BE-1.05; SG-04 justified. SFM-033 Stock safety functions unavailable or degraded while the item is installed (S 10; H-08). Effects: Stock ADAS camera messages blocked or replaced by the harness-box intercept / Stock AEB / FCW / lane assist not available as expected / Driver relies on stock protections that are not present. Causes: SFM-033.C1 The intercept routes the stock camera messages the vehicle needs for AEB through the panda (O 6, D 10, M -, AP H); SFM-033.C2 Item does not forward or reproduce stock safety messages (O 5, D 3, M -, AP H); SFM-033.C3 The harness box loses its supply (ignition branch or D1 open without comma power, VIN shorted), or a switch channel opens, so the stock camera path through the unpowered or open DG419LE switches is cut (RR-2026-010) (O 5, D 10, M -, AP H); SFM-033.C4 The panda MCU stops executing with the intercept driven, so forwarding stops and the stock camera stays cut off; the item's commands stop too (EPS timeout, AOU-01R). Since BL-005 the IWDG resets the MCU in about 90 ms, which releases the intercept (TSR-501, TSR-706); not verified on hardware (WP-A-04 OI-5) (O 3, D 8, M -, AP H); SFM-033.C5 The panda's car-side transceiver (bus 0) holds the bus dominant or babbles, so the vehicle ECUs lose the stock camera messages the panda forwards and the item's commands (TSR-508) (O 3, D 10, M -, AP H); SFM-033.C6 The panda's camera-side FDCAN or transceiver is stuck or error-passive, so camera-side reception stops and the stock PCS frames are not forwarded while the intercept is driven. The error counters and bus-off recovery (fdcan.h:76-84) do not release the intercept (SPF-13; TSR-707, TSR-706) (O 3, D 10, M -, AP H). Actions: SFM-ACT-003 open, SFM-ACT-006 open. Fault trees: SG-07 G7.1. SFM-034 Harness-box intercept switch stuck or in the wrong position (S 10; H-08, H-01, H-04, H-03). Effects: Intercept switch stuck or intermittent: in intercept when released (camera cut off from the car), or in pass-through when driven (stock camera and item both on the bus) / Conflicting steering/ACC messages, or no camera messages / Erratic stock or item behavior; stock functions lost ; Contributes to HZ-002: stock LKA and item steering requests combine on the bus ; Contributes to HZ-006: stock and item braking requests combine on the bus ; Contributes to HZ-005: stock ACC and item acceleration requests combine on the bus. Causes: SFM-034.C1 Switch U1 or U2 stuck in intercept, its IN input damaged high or driven high, its pull-down R2/R3 open, or the switches damaged by box supply transients (DG419LE, RR-2026-010) (O 4, D 10, M -, AP H); SFM-034.C2 Switch stuck in pass-through, or the SBU1 drive lost, held low or too low to change the switch over (5 V drive against VL = VIN) (O 3, D 9, M -, AP H). Actions: none. Fault trees: SG-01 BE-4.19, G1.4; SG-03 BE-4.19; SG-04 BE-4.19, G4.8; SG-07 BE-7.09, G7.3. SFM-035 Item sends a frame that alters the stock pre-collision function (S 10; H-08, H-04). Effects: A PCS-relevant frame from the SoC (0x344 PRE_COLLISION_2, 0x411 PCS_HUD, a DSU-only ID, or 0x283 PRE_COLLISION with a non-zero payload) reaches the car bus / Stock PCS warning or braking suppressed, altered or triggered by the item / Stock AEB/FCW degraded while the driver relies on it ; Contributes to HZ-006: PCS braking triggered by a frame from the item. Causes: SFM-035.C1 Host code (car interface, pandad) emits a PCS-relevant ID or a non-zero PRE_COLLISION payload (QM fault) (O 6, D 9, M 5, AP H, MSR AP H); SFM-035.C3 The TX whitelist or the PRE_COLLISION content check lets a PCS-relevant frame through (table change, or a build that is not the reference build, where 0x411 is allowed by design) (O 5, D 3, M 10, AP H, MSR AP H). Actions: none. Fault trees: SG-04 tree gap; SG-07 BE-7.08. SFM-036 Item keeps requesting acceleration while stock PCS brakes (S 10; H-08). Effects: ACC_CONTROL keeps carrying the planner's acceleration request while the stock camera reports a PCS braking event / PCS braking depends on the PCM giving it priority over the item's request (AOU-04R, unverified) / Stock AEB deceleration reduced or delayed if the PCM arbitrates otherwise. Causes: SFM-036.C1 Defect in the stand-down of DQ-300 A (#292): stock_aeb_stand_down not called or not capping the target and the upper PID limit while stockAeb is set, or the opendbc 0x343 cap not applied, so the item keeps requesting the planner's acceleration during a stock PCS event (FTA BE-7.13). Up to BL-006 the cause was a design gap: the item had no reaction to a stock PCS event on its longitudinal command (O 5, D 8, M 8, AP H, MSR AP H); SFM-036.C2 The PCM does not give stock PCS braking priority over the item's ACC_CONTROL request (AOU-04R not met) (O 3, D 10, M 7, AP H, MSR AP H). Actions: SFM-ACT-006 open, SFM-ACT-020 completed. Fault trees: SG-07 BE-7.13 (single point).
